import datetime
import re

_MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})")
_WEEK_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})-W(\d{2})")

        first = datetime.date(year, month, 1)

        return datetime.date(year, 1, 1), datetime.date(year, 12, 31)
